method: TP2-MV-ALiBi transformer, final (5-seed ensemble, causal p>=0.5 selection)
base_protocol: v3 (val-loss checkpoint, warm-up, grad clip 1.0, LR=3e-5)
selection_rule: fixed p>=0.5, zero tuning, fully causal
notes: Selection rule is a fixed constant (p>=0.5) compared per-trade against that trade's own seed-averaged calibrated probability -- no validation-year tuning, no reference to any other trade's prediction. Fully causal and live-deployable as-is.
Training: 5 independently-seeded models per fold, v3's exact protocol, raw probabilities averaged before one isotonic calibration per fold.
This script writes only *_v4final_* outputs; no v2/v3/v4/v3final artifact is modified.
